name: SIM800L
description: Quad-band GSM/GPRS modem — send SMS, check signal and network registration

ready.description: true if the modem answers AT with OK

registered.description: true when registered on the home or a roaming network

send_sms.description: Send an SMS in text mode; blocks up to 10 s waiting for the network

specs.current: 2 A bursts on transmit; 1000 µF+ across VCC/GND
specs.logic: 2.8V — TX is fine into a 3.3V MCU, put ~1 kΩ in series on RX

pins.label: VCC
pins.note: 4.0V from a Li-ion cell or a buck converter, never the MCU 3.3V pin

pins.label: RXD
pins.note: From MCU TX (GPIO17 on ESP32) via 1 kΩ

tips: Status LED: blink every 1 s = searching, every 3 s = registered, reboot loops = supply sag.
Registration takes 10-60 s after power-up; poll registered() before sending.
